one_line: Highly customizable, data-driven CRM with a REST API, real-time webhooks, an app SDK, and native MCP support.
auth_notes: OAuth2 for published third-party apps; workspace API tokens (bearer) for personal/workspace integrations. Developer platform also offers an App SDK (TypeScript/React) and SQL query interface.
self_serve_notes: Free tier exists; developers can create a workspace and issue API tokens without approval.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: REST API covering records, lists, objects, attributes, workspaces, notes, tasks, calendar events, and emails
api_surface.webhook_note: Subscribe to workspace events in realtime via webhooks (explicitly documented)

existing_mcp.note: MCP is a first-class part of the Attio developer platform ('Manage Attio via AI - connect Claude, ChatGPT or your AI tool of choice')

evidence.note: Fetched docs index confirmed REST API, webhooks, MCP, App SDK, and SQL access

agent_notes: Docs explicitly document MCP and webhooks; very buildable. Token vs OAuth details standard for modern SaaS.
